summary: QIAGEN N.V., a Dutch foreign private issuer listed on NYSE and Frankfurt, furnished a Form 6-K on November 6, 2026, carrying its November 4, 2026 press release of unaudited third-quarter 2026 results for the period ended September 30, 2026. The filing is an ordinary quarterly earnings disclosure, not a transaction. It details non-GAAP adjusted measures (gross profit, operating income, pre-tax income, net income, tax rate, diluted EPS) and free cash flow, excluding integration, acquisition, restructuring, impairment and intangible amortization items. No board recommendation, advisor, price, stake or regulatory clock is stated. Watch quarterly organic growth and adjusted margin trajectory rather than event-driven arbitrage.
